description: Nearest correlation matrix (correlation.nearest): verification and demonstration commands. Pure Python standard library; no dependencies to install.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Independent verification suite: structural constraints (symmetry, unit diagonal, PSD), independently recomputed dual lower bound D and F-D gap, primal-dual consistency B+ = matrix, cross-check against an independently written Dykstra solver, permutation equivariance, repeated-eigenvalue and singular-optimum cases, sub-optimality of one-shot eigenvalue truncation, Qi-Sun literature example, and input validation. Exits non-zero on any failure.

commands.name: demo
commands.description: Realistic monitoring-data demonstration: a pairwise-complete equity-sector correlation matrix and a four-name credit-book block, both non-PSD, with corrected matrix, dual vector, eigenvalues, objective F and lower bound D.

commands.name: demo-custom-json
commands.description: Run the demonstration on a user-supplied correlation matrix given as a JSON array of arrays.

commands.name: demo-custom-file
commands.description: Run the demonstration on a correlation matrix stored as JSON in a file.
